versions.content: {DRAFT} The ComM module shall be able to distribute the status of a particular PNC (result of the PNC state machine) across the assigned ComM channels. Therefore ComM shall forward the aggregated state of internal PNC request per communication channel (e.g. bus or network) as PNC bit vector by calling the API Nm_UpdateIRA(<channel>, <PNC bit vector of aggregated internal PNC requests>) . The IRA PNC bit vector designates the status of the internal PNC requests.
